/api/risk.ranking_order: risk_weighted_ha = sum over a village's fields of risk_score/100 x area_ha

method.formula: risk = 100 x dryness x (0.4 timing + 0.4 neighbourhood + 0.2 history)

factors.timing: 1.0 up to 10 days after harvest, falling to 0 at 30 days (harvest-to-wheat-sowing gap of 10-30 days)
factors.neighbourhood: FIRMS fires (nominal/high confidence) plus Sentinel-2 burns no satellite fire alert explains, within 5 km in the last 7 days; 1 - exp(-n / today's typical n)
factors.history: FIRMS vegetation fires within 5 km last season (15 Sep - 30 Nov); 1 - exp(-n / typical n)
factors.dryness: exp(-rain in the next 72 h / 10 mm); multiplies the rest

method.note: A transparent ranking, not a probability: it orders today's fields by how likely they are to burn next. See `backtest` for how well that ordering worked on this season.
